data.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
data.shortDescription: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe 🏖️ No timers, No stress 😌 cook traditional dishes 🍝 upgrade and customize 🏠 just drink Prosecco 🥂 relax and grow your dream cafe ✨

data.name: Winter Burrow
data.shortDescription: A cozy woodland survival game about a mouse restoring their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

data.name: Shelve the Potions!
data.shortDescription: Organize 2000+ potions on shelves after the witch's cats have knocked them over, using clues around an enchanted cellar. Learn strange symbols and decipher cryptic notes.

data.name: Heartopia
data.shortDescription: A multiplayer life simulation game crafted for creativity, freedom, and peace. Build your dream home, explore hobbies, and forge warm connections with friends in a cozy town.

data.name: Palia
data.shortDescription: A free-to-play fantasy life sim adventure where you can craft, explore, and create the life and home of your dreams in a vibrant, heartwarming world.

data.name: Cat Mail Co.
data.shortDescription: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages. Clear a strange backlog and unlock new destinations.

data.name: Leaf it Alone
data.shortDescription: Finally, it's that time of the year to clean up this leafy mess. Derust your raking skills and don't waste a second — there's a whole lawn waiting!

data.name: Leafy Corner
data.shortDescription: Run a cute little plant shop. Grow, sell, and care for real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop.

data.name: Grimshire
data.shortDescription: A deadly plague threatens the village of Grimshire. Manage farmland, forage wilds, stop harvest rot and keep the cellar full. Can you help the community survive?

data.name: Tiny Glade
data.shortDescription: A small diorama builder where you doodle whimsical castles, cozy cottages & romantic ruins. No management, combat or goals — just lovable dioramas.

data.name: Whisper of the House
data.shortDescription: A cozy organizing & decorating game. Help townspeople move, organize, and clean their spaces. Your gentle touch may change their lives and uncover hidden stories.

data.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
data.shortDescription: A cute cozy puzzle adventure. Play as a forest spirit exploring hand-drawn magical locations, meet charming characters, solve puzzles, collect herbs and tea recipes.

data.name: Cat Chess
data.shortDescription: Play the ancient and thrilling game of Chess but with... cats! Lead your furry friends to the Purrfect battle of brains and whiskers!

data.name: Cast n Chill
data.shortDescription: A relaxing fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion.

data.name: Little Corners
data.shortDescription: Peel, place, and arrange stickers across tiny windows into different worlds. Relax and unwind to lofi beats, collect unique stickers and share cozy creations.

data.name: Tailside: Cozy Cafe Sim
data.shortDescription: Run your own cozy café in Tailside! Brew coffee, decorate your café, follow small stories in the daily newspaper. Unlock new items, skills, villagers, and creature visitors.

data.name: ISLANDERS: New Shores
data.shortDescription: Build your island retreat in a calm, minimalist world with exciting new features that keep the classic charm while inspiring fresh creativity.

data.name: Camper Van: Make it Home
data.shortDescription: Decorate and organize the camper van of your dreams! Build your own home-on-wheels using creative block organization puzzles and relaxing interior design.

data.name: Organized Inside
data.shortDescription: A slow-paced life sim and tidying up game about a cat, passion, transformation and growth. Categorize household items while uncovering the meaning of life through organization.

data.name: Cozy Solitaire
data.shortDescription: Classic Solitaire game, accompanied by music and kitties.

data.name: Cozy Sudoku
data.shortDescription: Sudoku, tunes, and some furry friends.

data.name: KoroNeko
data.shortDescription: Roll your way through a cozy, kawaii world full of charming characters and challenging puzzles to save your siblings from Strawberry the Witch!

data.name: Wytchwood
data.shortDescription: A crafting adventure game set in a land of gothic fables. As the old witch, explore, collect ingredients, brew spells, and pass judgement upon a capricious cast of characters.

data.name: The Wild at Heart
data.shortDescription: Wield a herd of quirky creatures to rebuild paths, battle beasts, and solve puzzles in a rich, interconnected nostalgic storybook fantasy world.
